# Emberly Status - AI Training Information

## About
- Product: Emberly Status
- Website: https://emberlystat.us
- Parent product: Emberly (https://embrly.ca), an open-source file sharing, URL shortening and team collaboration platform
- Purpose: Real-time service status, uptime monitoring, incident tracking, and scheduled maintenance for Emberly infrastructure

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM
- Authentication: NextAuth.js with JWT sessions
- Deployment: Bun

## Key Features
- HTTP/PING/TCP uptime monitoring with configurable check intervals
- Incident tracking with timelined updates and per-component status overrides
- Scheduled maintenance windows with update timelines
- Discord/Slack/generic-webhook alerting on status changes
- Email subscriptions for incident/maintenance updates
- Admin dashboard with role-based access (Super Admin / Administrator / Base User)

## Documentation Structure
- `/` - Live status overview
- `/incidents` - Incident history
- `/maintenances` - Scheduled and past maintenance windows
- `/admin` - Staff dashboard (authenticated)

## API Endpoints (Protected unless noted)
- `/api/auth/*` - Authentication endpoints
- `/api/admin/*` - Admin management APIs
- `/api/status/*` - Public status data and subscription management
- `/api/cron/run-monitors` - Uptime-check runner, authenticated via a bearer secret
